senses.definition: the syllable naming the fifth (dominant) note of any musical scale in solmization
to a very great extent or degree
examples: the idea is so obvious
never been so happy
I love you so
my head aches so!

senses.definition: in a manner that facilitates
examples: he observed the snakes so he could describe their behavior
he stooped down so he could pick up his hat

senses.definition: in such a condition or manner, especially as expressed or implied
examples: They're happy and I hope they will remain so
so live your life that old age will bring no regrets

senses.definition: to a certain unspecified extent or degree
examples: I can only go so far with this student
can do only so much in a day

senses.definition: in the same way; also
examples: I was offended and so was he
worked hard and so did she

senses.definition: in the way indicated
examples: hold the brush so
set up the pieces thus

senses.definition: (usually followed by ‘that’) to an extent or degree as expressed
examples: he was so tired he could hardly stand
so dirty that it smells

senses.definition: subsequently or soon afterward (often used as sentence connectors)
examples: then he left
go left first, then right
first came lightning, then thunder
we watched the late movie and then went to bed
and so home and to bed

senses.definition: (used to introduce a logical conclusion) from that fact or reason or as a result
examples: therefore X must be true
the eggs were fresh and hence satisfactory
we were young and thence optimistic
it is late and thus we must go
the witness is biased and so cannot be trusted

senses.definition: in truth (often tends to intensify)
examples: they said the car would break down and indeed it did
it is very cold indeed
was indeed grateful
indeed, the rain may still come
he did so do it!

senses.definition: used in negative statement to describe a situation that has existed up to this point or up to the present time
examples: So far he hasn't called
the sun isn't up yet

senses.definition: to the degree or extent that
examples: insofar as it can be ascertained, the horse lung is comparable to that of man
so far as it is reasonably practical he should practice restraint

senses.definition: used after a superlative
examples: this is the best so far
the largest drug bust yet

senses.definition: a farewell remark
examples: they said their good-byes

senses.definition: as if it were really so
examples: she lives here, as it were

senses.definition: in a manner of speaking
examples: the feeling is, as we say, quite dead

senses.definition: In other words, as a result
a person who is deemed to be despicable or contemptible
examples: only a rotter would do that
kill the rat
throw the bum out
you cowardly little pukes!
the British call a contemptible person a ‘git’

senses.definition: doubtful or suspect
examples: these so-called experts are no help

senses.definition: being neither good nor bad
examples: an indifferent performance
a gifted painter but an indifferent actor
a so-so golfer
feeling only so-so

senses.definition: in an acceptable (but not outstanding) manner
examples: she plays tennis tolerably
